description: A woman with dark hair pulled back, in a patterned sleeveless dress, spreads a dark chocolate paste on a slice of bread with a knife. A small child with brown hair watches from beside her. In front of them on a worn wooden table are a glass jar of the same paste, a plate, a metal lid, several whole hazelnuts and some hazelnut husks. The kitchen has tiled walls, a copper pot, a window with sunlight, and a jug on the counter. The style is a warm oil painting, edge to edge.
